meta.title: Participant demographics — Pán Prstenů
meta.description: Participant demographics for the Pán Prstenů LARP: growth of the event since 1992, detailed breakdown of years 2024–2026, year-on-year trends.

hero.lead: How many we are each year, who we are, and how Pán Prstenů changes year by year.

intro.lead: During registration we collect (with your consent) the data we need to organise the event — and at the same time these data allow us to paint a demographic picture of the Pán Prstenů community. The statistics are pre-aggregated — individual records never leave the registration system.

data_categories.label: Side and army
data_categories.desc: (Free Peoples, Forces of the Dark Lord, Mercenaries, Non-playing companions, Children's game) and factions within (Gondor, Rohan, Elves, Dwarves, Orcs, Harad, Umbar, Wold).

data_categories.label: Age
data_categories.desc: — calculated from the year of birth. Used for the age pyramid and generational composition.

data_categories.label: Weapon choice
data_categories.desc: — one-handed, shield, long, bow, spear — for in-game logistics and balance.

data_categories.label: Group or warband
data_categories.desc: — who you bring with you (families, parties, warbands). Used for Lorenz and Simpson group-cohesion analyses.

data_categories.label: Registration date
data_categories.desc: — for the registration dynamics (who signs up early, who at the last minute).

intro.api_note_prefix: No personal data (names, e-mails, contacts) is published in this archive. The pages rely exclusively on aggregated numbers — see API endpoint

cards.title: Year-on-year comparison
cards.desc: Trends 2024 → 2026 side by side: attendance, age, armies, weapons, gender, registration dynamics. 10 chart sections.

cards.title: Year 2026
cards.desc: Current registration. Figures update in real time as sign-ups roll in. Tracked through the event day on 22 Aug 2026.

cards.title: Year 2025
cards.desc: Second-strongest modern year — 689 participants, main battle on 23 Aug 2025. Detailed breakdown of armies, age, groups.

cards.title: Year 2024
cards.desc: 511 participants, main battle on 24 Aug 2024. Mercenaries were still part of the Dark Forces — the side restructure only happened in 2025.
